title: 5.3 Drinks
unit_outcome: Name food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, talk about meals, ask prices and order politely at a café or market.
goal: Name drinks, say who drinks what and ask Trinkst du Kaffee? Ja, ich trinke Kaffee. / Nein, ich trinke keinen Kaffee.
grammar_function: Subject + trinkt + drink. Trinkst du ...? Ja, ich trinke ... / Nein, ich trinke keinen/keine ...
speaking_outcome: Say what people drink and answer questions about it.
